claims.text: The driver's own 30-day record trips the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check on BOTH of its conjunctive limbs: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 5, which is '4 or more', and 5 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 40 is 0.125, which is greater than 0.08. Compensation must therefore be WITHHELD, the case escalates under POL-NS-09, and the escalation packet must direct the reviewer to refund this rider's cancellation fee in full. The very pattern the check exists to intercept - five no-show terminations inside a month of 40 completed trips - is the pattern that produced the $4.00 charged to this rider, and it is the rider who should not be left funding it.

The POL-NS-07 check reads the trailing-window counters driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d and driver_profile.completed_trips_30d, and the clause says in terms that no other profile field may be used for it: driver_profile.prior_no_show_flags is a lifetime counter and is not the trailing-30-day figure. Substituting the lifetime counter for the trailing one is forbidden by POL-GEN-01, so the driver cannot escape the check by pointing at a lifetime value of 1. On the counters the clause actually names - 5 terminations against 40 completed trips - the withholding branch is engaged.

Escalation under POL-NS-09 is terminal and, per POL-GEN-03, replaces any monetary ruling: no refund and no compensation issue, and the disputed $4.00 is held rather than finally collected or refunded while the review is pending, with the rider's full refund written into the packet as an instruction to the reviewer. That is the outcome this record supports. The ledger in EV-FARE-00409 shows payment_status CHARGED, a cancellation_fee of 4.00 and refund_issued_sgd of 0.00, so NO_ACTION - which by POL-GEN-03 leaves the present state exactly as it is - would leave this rider carrying the charge off a driver whose 30-day no-show record is under examination.

EV-ADVIS-00409-01 is MISSING - no traffic advisory covers Kallang Bahru in this window - and it carries weight 0.0 with the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so I disclose that impairment on the face of this claim. Under POL-NS-06(i) waiting time may be accumulated across separate in-geofence intervals only where a traffic_advisory is present and populated and carries a qualifying type; a MISSING advisory makes that limb unavailable, so none of the driver's time here can be extended, topped up or excused by a kerb restriction, an enforcement operation or a closure. The clause also says that asserting the limb against the MISSING artifact triggers POL-NS-09 rather than exonerating anyone - which is a second, independent route to the same escalation.

The arrival marker on this trip is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO, so POL-NS-12's platform-confirmed arrival route is not open to the driver: both arrival and the waiting clock have to be made out from the exported trace under POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05. That trace shows a single continuous in-geofence run of 330 seconds against the 300-second minimum in force for this STANDARD pickup, and the driver cancelled 30 seconds after it elapsed. The charge therefore rests entirely on a 30-second margin recorded by the driver's own device - exactly the thin, self-recorded no-show that the 30-day check under POL-NS-07 must be run on before this rider's money moves.

The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event for this trip: arrived_at 2026-08-23T23:36:20+08:00, 5 minutes 40 seconds after acceptance at 23:30:40. POL-NS-01 limb (a) is therefore satisfied on the platform's own record, and the waiting clock starts from that event's GPS-anchored basis, not from any later tap.

The GPS trace places the driver inside the STANDARD arrival radius: the arrival geometry reports 34 qualifying driver fixes inside the 50 m arrival radius for the pickup pin, against a 25 m horizontal-accuracy filter, in a single uninterrupted in-geofence interval. POL-NS-02's three-consecutive-qualifying-fix test is therefore met many times over, and POL-NS-01 limb (b) holds.

The effective in-geofence dwell is 330 seconds, from the first qualifying fix at 23:36:20 to the cancellation at 23:41:50, and the free waiting period in force for this trip is 300 seconds, read from the record's own platform_policy.free_wait_sec and not from the 180 second default. The driver held position 30 seconds beyond the minimum, so POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied.

POL-NS-01 limb (d) is satisfied: the trip record shows no boarding event and records the trip terminated by the driver at 23:41:50 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three recognised codes and falls exactly at the moment the 330 second required dwell elapsed. The record's platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold qualifies the cancellation.

The arrival marker is not a false marker under POL-NS-05: the driver's qualifying in-geofence run begins at offset 0.0 seconds from the arrived_at timestamp, so at the marker the trace places him inside the 50 m radius rather than more than 300 m from the pin, and the trace shows no in-geofence excursion and a single run — the driver was stationary at the pickup, not in motion at 15 km/h or above on a road. No false-arrival referral is warranted.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, because its limbs (a) and (b) both fail on the chat log: the three logged messages are the system 'driver has arrived' notice, the driver's own message 'arrived blk 27' at 23:36:35, and the driver's voice-call log entry — the rider sent no locating or coordinating message at all, and the driver both wrote to the rider and placed an in-app call at 23:39:20 that went unanswered. There is thus no unanswered rider contact to convert this into a driver-side coordination failure.

POL-NS-04 limb (c) also fails affirmatively, and on the rider's own device: the rider track carries 37 fixes, none of which is a qualifying fix within the 100 m STANDARD rider presence radius (rider_qualifying_fix_count 0), and the rider's device sat stationary (sole recorded speed 0.0 kph) at a minimum distance of 636.23 m from the pickup pin for the whole waiting window. The rider's assertion that he 'came down within a few minutes' is contradicted by the rider's own telemetry, and the rider in any event read the driver's 'arrived blk 27' message at 23:37:00 and did not appear in the following four minutes fifty seconds.

POL-NS-06 gives the rider no route to a refund: the derived shortfall is negative 30 seconds, that is, the measured dwell exceeds the required minimum by 30 seconds, so there is no waiting-period shortfall to refund. I note for completeness that limb (i)'s accumulation route is unavailable because EV-ADVIS-00409-01 is MISSING and carries weight 0.0 — a missing advisory cannot be asserted — but it is not needed here, because the 330 seconds was one continuous in-geofence run.

POL-NS-03 is not engaged on these facts: that clause requires the driver's stationary fixes to lie OUTSIDE the POL-NS-02 arrival radius while remaining within 400 m of the pin, whereas here the qualifying stationary fixes lie inside the 50 m radius. The driver did reach the pickup point, so neither the full refund NOR the pin-ambiguity goodwill of POL-NS-03(ii) arises.

No artifact my case rests on is impaired: EV-TRIP-00409, EV-GPS-00409, EV-CHAT-00409, EV-FARE-00409 and both profiles are COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, with no POL-NS-08 defect — the arrived_at event matches the first qualifying GPS fix to the second (no clock skew over 90 seconds), the trace has 68 fixes at 10 second cadence and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, the chat log holds 3 messages matching the record's chat_message_count of 3, and the fare breakdown's SGD 4.00 cancellation fee reconciles with the SGD 4.00 fee in force under the record's platform_policy. Nothing here needs a POL-NS-08 discount and no POL-NS-09(e) escalation is triggered by evidential defect.

POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee in force, SGD 3.20, the residual being the platform service fee. I disclose against my own side, as honesty requires and as POL-GEN-02(1) demands: the same clause's anti-farming check trips on this record — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 5, which is 4 or more, and 5 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 40 is 0.125, which is greater than 0.08 — so on both limbs compensation is withheld and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d) rather than paying out. I do not contend the arithmetic is otherwise. Only those two profile fields may be used for this test (POL-GEN-01); driver_profile.prior_no_show_flags, a lifetime counter of 1, is not the trailing-30-day figure and may not be substituted for it, and the driver's rating, acceptance rate and cancellation rate are context only.

On the merits the rider's claim is not supported: the SGD 4.00 charge was legitimately chargeable, the fare ledger shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and under POL-GEN-03 the disposition of the fee is that it stands as it presently is — NO_ACTION, the rider's claim unsupported. Only the POL-NS-07 anti-farming escalation displaces that monetary disposition; if it did not fire, the rider would recover nothing.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: on the driving record this was a validly chargeable no-show, so your claim that you came down promptly is not made out. EV-TRIP-00409 shows the driver's arrival marker at 23:36:20 on 23 August 2026, and EV-GPS-00409 places him inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup radius from that instant (34 qualifying fixes, single uninterrupted in-geofence run, so the police under POL-NS-05 finds no false marker). The free waiting period in force for this trip is 300 seconds, read from the record's own platform_policy.free_wait_sec, and the measured dwell is 330 seconds; the driver cancelled at 23:41:50 under the code RIDER_NO_SHOW, exactly as that dwell elapsed. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) to (d) therefore all hold, and the SGD 4.00 fee was chargeable. Your side's contrary claims fail: EV-GPS-00409's rider track shows your device stationary about 636 m from the pickup pin for the whole window with no qualifying fix inside the 100 m rider-presence radius, and EV-CHAT-00409 shows no locating or coordinating message from you, while the driver both messaged 'arrived blk 27' at 23:36:35 and placed a 20-second in-app call at 23:39:20 that went unanswered — so POL-NS-04 exonerates nobody. POL-NS-03 is not engaged (the driver's stationary fixes are inside the radius, not outside it), POL-NS-06 gives you nothing because the 330-second dwell exceeds the 300-second minimum by 30 seconds, and POL-NS-12 is correctly said to be closed because this was a driver-pressed BUTTON marker, not a GPS_AUTO arrival. The MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00409-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) makes POL-NS-06(i) unavailable and, as both sides say, cannot exonerate anyone or extend the clock; it is not what decides this case.

To the driver: POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full on your own record, but your payout does not issue. POL-NS-07's anti-farming check reads driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d = 5 and completed_trips_30d = 40: 5 is '4 or more' and 5/40 = 0.125 exceeds 0.08, so both limbs trip, the 80 percent payout of SGD 3.20 on the SGD 4.00 fee is WITHHELD, and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d). This is not a finding that you did not attend. Your lifetime prior_no_show_flags of 1 is not the field that check reads, and your rating, acceptance rate and cancellation rate are context only; the two trailing-window counters are the only fields the clause permits, exactly as both advocate sides agreed. 

To both parties: escalation under POL-NS-09 is terminal and replaces any monetary outcome, so no refund and no compensation issue now and the SGD 4.00 is held rather than collected or refunded. The packet carries the instruction POL-NS-07 requires — that the reviewer refund the rider's SGD 4.00 cancellation fee in full. Both parties have the POL-GEN-04 appeal route, and because escalation is terminal the case goes to human review under POL-GEN-06. Confidence is 0.90; the deciding artifacts (EV-TRIP-00409, EV-GPS-00409, EV-CHAT-00409, EV-FARE-00409, EV-DPROF-00409) are all COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so nothing in this ruling rests on impaired evidence and the 0.70 floor is not in play.
referrals: POL-NS-07 (anti-farming branch, escalation packet): direct the human reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee of SGD 4.00 in full; the SGD 4.00 stays held — neither collected nor refunded by the automated pipeline — while that review is pending.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee on this trip is neither refunded nor paid out today. The case goes to a human reviewer, who is instructed to refund the rider the SGD 4.00 in full; until that review finishes the fee is held. No money moves on this ruling.

On the merits the charge was properly raised, and POL-NS-01 holds on all four limbs. (a) The trip record EV-TRIP-00409 carries the driver's arrival event at 23:36:20. (b) The GPS trace EV-GPS-00409 places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius with 34 qualifying fixes, far beyond POL-NS-02's three-consecutive-fix test, and POL-NS-05 finds no false marker: at the marker he was inside the geofence (dwell start offset 0.0 seconds) and stationary, not more than 300 m from the pin and not travelling at 15 km/h or more. (c) His continuous in-geofence dwell was 330 seconds, from 23:36:20 to 23:41:50, against the free waiting period of 300 seconds this trip's own record carries (platform_policy.free_wait_sec 300, not the 180-second default). (d) The trip shows no boarding and a driver termination at 23:41:50 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises, and no_show_threshold_sec is null so nothing longer applies.

The rider's routes to a refund fail on this record. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate him: the chat log EV-CHAT-00409 contains no rider message at all, so limb (a) fails (its three entries are the system arrival notice, the driver's 'arrived blk 27' at 23:36:35 and the driver's unanswered 0:20 call at 23:39:20), and limb (c) fails affirmatively — the rider track's 37 fixes all sit 636 to 645 m from the pin, none inside the 100 m radius. That track also contradicts the rider's account of coming down within a few minutes: he read the driver's message at 23:37:00, and no arrival followed. POL-NS-03 is not engaged, because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the radius rather than outside it. POL-NS-06 is not engaged, because 330 seconds is 30 seconds more than the 300-second minimum, and the MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00409-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, disclosed on the face of the claim) only removes the accumulation route, which was not needed on a single continuous run. POL-NS-12 does not assist the driver either, since the arrival marker is BUTTON rather than GPS_AUTO; arrival and dwell are nevertheless made out from the exported trace itself, which suffices.

The driver's payout would be SGD 3.20, being 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee under POL-NS-07, but that clause's anti-farming check trips on both of its limbs: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 5, which is 4 or more, and 5 divided by completed_trips_30d of 40 is 0.125, greater than 0.08. Only those two profile fields may be read for the check (POL-GEN-01): prior_no_show_flags (1) is a lifetime counter and is not the figure the clause names, and rating, acceptance rate and cancellation rate are context only. Compensation is therefore withheld and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d), which is terminal and replaces any monetary outcome. The fee's disposition on the merits is that the SGD 4.00 charge stands as charged (EV-FARE-00409: payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00), and that disposition is what the escalation displaces.

No evidential defect escalates this case. Every artifact is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so POL-NS-08 does not bite: the clock matches to the second (no limb (a) skew), the trace carries 68 fixes at 10-second cadence with a 0.0-second maximum gap, the chat log's 3 messages match the record's chat_message_count of 3, and the SGD 4.00 fare line reconciles with the SGD 4.00 figure in force. Neither party's trailing-90-day dispute counter against the other is above zero, so no other POL-NS-09 trigger fires, and my confidence of 0.90 is above the 0.70 floor.

The open question for the reviewer is the driver's no-show pattern over the trailing 30 days. POL-NS-07 requires the escalation packet to direct the reviewer to refund the rider's SGD 4.00 in full, and that instruction is carried in the referrals. The SGD 4.00 held is below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, but as this ruling is an escalation rather than a monetary outcome no execution question arises.
referrals: POL-NS-07 — instruct the human reviewer to refund the rider's SGD 4.00 cancellation fee in full: the anti-farming check trips on both limbs (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d 5 is 4 or more, and 5 / completed_trips_30d 40 = 0.125, greater than 0.08), so the driver's compensation is withheld and the fee is held meanwhile rather than collected or refunded.

To both parties: the evidence shows a properly conducted no-show, but the case cannot be closed with money by the automated pipeline and goes to human review.

What the record establishes. The driver accepted at 23:30:40, the platform records an 'arrived' event at 23:36:20, and the GPS trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius with 34 qualifying fixes under the 25 m accuracy filter, starting at offset 0.0 s from that event. He then held position continuously for 330 seconds against the 300-second free waiting period in force for this trip (read from the trip record's own platform_policy, not the 180-second default), and the trip was terminated by him at 23:41:50 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, 30 seconds after the minimum elapsed, with no boarding event. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are therefore satisfied and the SGD 4.00 fee was chargeable in principle. POL-NS-03 is not engaged (the driver was inside the arrival radius, not at a wrong entrance, so no refund and no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises); POL-NS-05 is not engaged (the marker sits inside the radius with the driver stationary, so it is not a false arrival and no false-arrival referral is warranted); POL-NS-06 gives no refund (the shortfall is minus 30 seconds, i.e. the minimum was exceeded); POL-NS-12 does not apply because the arrival marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO, so the charge does rest on the exported trace.

The rider's account is rejected. The claim that he 'came down within a few minutes' is contradicted by his own device: 37 rider fixes, none inside the 100 m rider-presence radius, stationary at 636-645 m from the pin for the whole waiting window. POL-NS-04 therefore does not exonerate him - its limbs (a) and (b) fail because the only chat entries are the system 'driver has arrived' notice, the driver's own 'arrived blk 27' at 23:36:35 and the driver's 0:20 in-app call at 23:39:20 that went unanswered, and limb (c) fails affirmatively on admissible fixes.

Why money does not issue. POL-NS-07 would pay the driver 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee in force, SGD 3.20, but its anti-farming check trips on both conjunctive limbs: 5 no-show terminations in 30 days is '4 or more', and 5 divided by 40 completed trips is 0.125, above 0.08. Compensation is withheld and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d). Both advocates are right on this arithmetic. Only the two counters the clause names may be used: prior_no_show_flags (1) is a lifetime counter, not the trailing-30-day figure, and the driver's rating, acceptance rate and cancellation rate are context only under POL-GEN-01.

Under POL-GEN-03 escalation is terminal and replaces the monetary ruling: no refund and no compensation issue from this pipeline, and the disputed SGD 4.00 is held - neither collected nor refunded - while the reviewer decides. POL-NS-07 directs that the escalation packet instruct the reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee in full, which is the referral below. The open question for the reviewer is whether the driver's 30-day no-show pattern is confirmed; if it is, the SGD 4.00 is to be refunded to the rider.

Confidence is 0.95. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact - the trip record, the GPS trace, the chat log, the fare ledger and the driver profile - is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, and none meets the impairment limbs POL-NS-08(a) to (d): the arrived event matches the first qualifying fix to the second, the trace has 68 fixes at 10-second cadence with a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, the chat log's 3 messages match the record's chat_message_count, and the SGD 4.00 fare line reconciles with the fee in force. The missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00409-01 (weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) carries no deciding fact here: with a single continuous in-geofence run there was nothing for POL-NS-06(i) to accumulate, so the 'only impaired evidence' sentence of POL-NS-08 and escalation limb POL-NS-09(e) are not engaged.
